race.comment: Open race to close out the card. MALUKU (4) hasn't done much wrong with two wins and a second from three starts to date and will strip fitter with that first-up effort now in the locker. Looks to have plenty of upside and only needs some luck navigating from the sticky draw to be playing a major role in the outcome. AGATHA (10) just missed the frame in town when resuming and wasn't too far away from the winner. Better for that hit-out and a win is not out of the equation. LITTLE IRIS (6) resumes here but the form she showed in her first campaign was good enough for a race of this nature. Can run a race while fresh. COOL WATERS (13) grows a leg for hoop Morgan who has two wins and a placing from just three steers. Don't dismiss lightly. SCILLATO (1) is worth consideration with J Mac on top while PIN UP SHEILA (14) resumes and puts an unbeaten record on the line.
